title: Classic dense Edgar
caption: A fictional young Latino man wearing a compact Edgar with dense dark hair, a blunt horizontal fringe and tightly faded sides.
patternDescription: Presented with a dense Type 1C-like texture whose slight natural body supports the rounded top while allowing the blunt fringe to remain sharply visible; the image does not establish a real person's natural subtype.
lengthDescription: Short overall, with closely faded sides and back and several centimeters of dense hair retained through the top and forward fringe.
